question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Together
solution:
The correct answer is '**Apart**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's go through the meanings of the words and then select the appropriate **antonym** for "**together**":

 
 
• **Apart** (अलग) - separated by a distance in time or space; not close to each other.
 
• **United** (एकत्र) - joined together politically or for a common purpose; in agreement or harmony.
 
• **Freight** (सामान) - goods transported by truck, train, ship, or aircraft; cargo.
 
• **Engulf** (लपेटना) - (verb) to completely surround or cover something; to immerse or swallow up. 
 
 
 
• Among these options, the most appropriate **antonym for "together" is: Apart**.
 
• Explanation:
 
• "**Together**" means in proximity or close association with each other, while "**apart**" means separated or distant from each other. They are direct opposites in terms of spatial or temporal relationships.
 
• ***Sentence using the correct option:**__** **After spending several years abroad, the siblings decided to live **apart**, pursuing their individual dreams and aspirations.*
 
• In this sentence, "**apart**" is the **antonym** of "**together**," **indicating the opposite state of being close or united.**
